QUOTE: The part before the colon is an fnmatch glob on the tool name. For example, `filesystem.*` matches every filesystem tool. Without a colon, the tool-name match is enough.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `pattern_matches` splits at the first colon, uses fnmatch on the tool-name part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
